name: Marrying the Villain
source:
When you go with your hero-crush to stop a supervillain, you expect crime fighting and fun – but it turns out the villain has an unexpected surprise waiting for you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
跟暗戀的英雄一起去阻止超級反派，你本以為會是一趟打擊犯罪、充滿樂趣的旅程。誰知，反派卻為你準備了一份意料之外的驚喜。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
